name: BRKN_70'S PAINTED ART
description: This LoRA is inspired by the painted graphic novels of the 1970s, with loose, expressive brushwork and rich, vibrant color. It was trained on 116 images (both scenes and characters) over 6,000 steps at strength 34, with the goal of capturing the feeling of that era rather than locking you into one character, background, or setting. With the right prompting you can approximate this look with a base model, but this LoRA ties it all together: intricate compositions, strong silhouettes, bold shading, and saturated palettes that feel like vintage covers brought to life. It works just as well for quiet character portraits as for dynamic action scenes, and it’s flexible in time and space, use it for retro city, fantasy worlds, or far-future sci-fi and it still holds its style. Usage tips • Recommended weight: 0.8 – 1.2 . You can push it higher, but you’ll start to lose some of the subtlety (sometimes in interesting ways, so feel free to experiment). • Works on most samplers/schedulers; my best results so far were with Euler and Simple . Expect the feel and line quality to shift a lot when you change sampler, which can be used creatively. Prompt exemple : Trigger: BRKN_70s_paint_art 1. Void Diver A lone astronaut in a bulky retro spacesuit drifting through an endless purple void, tethered to nothing, helmet reflecting impossible geometries, arms outstretched in surrender or embrace, tiny against cosmic immensity, 70s sci-fi book cover style, painted texture, muted oranges and deep violets 2. Machine Garden A woman in flowing white robes tending to mechanical flowers in a greenhouse on a space station, chrome petals unfurling, copper stems, her face serene among the artificial blooms, Earth visible through curved glass ceiling, soft diffused light, 70s European comic art style, painterly brush strokes 3. The Awakening Giant humanoid figure emerging from cracked desert earth, ancient and mechanical, cables and tubes trailing like veins, tiny robed pilgrims gathered at its feet in worship, rust red sky with two suns, scale emphasizing insignificance of humans, 70s prog rock album cover aesthetic 4. Neural Throne A bald woman seated on a throne of intertwined cables and screens, eyes closed, third eye glowing on forehead, data streams visualized as luminous threads connecting her to a city below, cyberpunk temple setting, incense smoke mixing with holographic displays, Moebius-inspired linework with watercolor washes 5. The Last Bazaar Crowded alien marketplace inside a hollowed asteroid, multiple species bartering under bioluminescent fungal lighting, human trader in worn leather jacket examining a crystalline artifact, steam rising from food stalls, cluttered maximalist composition, warm amber and teal palette, Heavy Metal magazine illustration style
